race.comment: SASSY FOR SURE (3) sets the standard after a first-up BM64 win at Port Lincoln and a close BM68 third there last start, when sent out favourite and beaten a length by The Wirrulla Boy. She is race fit third-up, has already won at around 1200m, and the 3kg claim helps offset the higher weight. CUBAN WATERS (8) has been plain in two runs back, but she eases back from Saturday company, is a proven track-and-trip winner and reunites with Teagan Voorham, who has won twice on her. JE CITY (5) brings consistent Class 2 form, including a close fourth at Murray Bridge after racing keenly and being bumped, and his record at this track keeps him right in the mix. SASSY SOPHIE (10) is back from a spell with mixed trials. Track record and Jason Holder help and can contest for a place.
